This process takes place in the chloroplasts of plant cells, which contain chlorophyll, the pigment responsible for capturing light energy. The overall equation for photosynthesis can be summarized as:

6 CO2 (carbon dioxide) + 6 H2O (water) + light energy → C6H12O6 (glucose) + 6 O2 (oxygen)
